text.p: Tropical Cyclone 07B is weakening as it tracks further inland in south India. It is still causing heavy rain and flooding but winds have diminished. Winds will further diminish this period as the system dissipates while moving westward. The full extend of the damage will probably not be known for another day or two. We expect that the damage due to flooding, mudslides, a storm surge and very strong winds will be extemely high...especially in Andhra Pradesh.

Tropical Cyclone Melanie-Bellamine is a very powerful storm with 120 mph top winds. The storm threatens only shipping in the southern Indian Ocean. It is centered near 13s/77e and tracking to the west southwest. It is expected to pick up foward speed and graudally weaken over the next 48 hours.
Tropical depression 12e is mostly a minor risk to shipping in the eastern Pacific.

Typhoon Dale is moving to the west and will pass south of Guam this period, producing only wind/rain squalls in Guam. Dale will intensify and become a major threat to shipping as top winds reach or exceed 100 mph. This system may become a supertypoon with winds up to 150 mph in 48 hours.

Tropical Storm Ernie is become an increasing risk to shipping in the South China Sea. Top winds, now at 55 mph, may reach 85 mph in about 48 hours. The system may threaten Hainan China or Vietnam later in the period.
